user.title: Configure Scene Lifecycle
user.description: Set up a new managed scene lifecycle. The target scene cannot be changed after setup.

data_description.managed_areas: Select entire rooms to snapshot and restore (e.g. 'Living Room').
data_description.transition_time: Time it takes to fade the lights when activating/deactivating.
data_description.duration: Time in seconds before the scene automatically deactivates (0 = disable).
data_description.reset_script: Script to run right before the scene turns off (useful to reset LED strip colors before they power down).

error.scene_not_found: The target scene could not be found.

abort.already_configured: This scene is already being managed by another entry.
